summary: Stefano Pezzella, 37, of Quincy, Illinois, drowned on a private two-boat raft trip in the Royal Gorge when his raft flipped in Sunshine Rapid around 3 p.m.; he was swept toward Sledgehammer Rapid while his two boatmates reached shore; nearby commercial guides pulled him out, attempted CPR and used an AED, and EMTs also treated him, but he was pronounced dead around 3:40 p.m.; flush drowning.
location: Sunshine Rapid, Royal Gorge, Arkansas River
responding_agency: Nearby commercial rafting guides; emergency medical technicians; Colorado Parks and Wildlife
notes: Source: American Whitewater accident record quoting the Pueblo Chieftain ('Two men who drowned on Arkansas River identified'); narrative parent-verified via the record's wp-json (id 82615). Fremont County Coroner Randy Keller. Inserted run 1014 (Chieftain chunk).
